top_issues: Dense stacked visual explanations overpower primary balance metrics.
fixes: Simplify bar breakdown card and increase contrast on smaller labels.

top_issues: Multiple before/after balance bars create cognitive friction during payment.
fixes: Collapse comparative state into an expandable secondary panel.

top_issues: Proof hash and verification indicators use low-emphasis text weight.
fixes: Promote verification state and simplify actions bar.

top_issues: QR presentation lacks visual priority against secondary capacity selectors.
fixes: Center QR block and elevate primary share mechanism.

top_issues: Order book depth lines crowd the trade execution ticket.
fixes: Clarify separation between input form and book depth metrics.

top_issues: Overlapping tooltip and collateral sliders obscure submission controls.
fixes: Reposition tooltip and untangle credit limit adjustments.

top_issues: Uncovered debt versus collateral terminology requires technical inference.
fixes: Add visual grouping around net position and guarantee status.

top_issues: Modal transparency causes severe readability drop over underlying text.
fixes: Make modal backdrop solid and clarify dispute resolution steps.

top_issues: Status pills and metadata tags blend together without strong rhythm.
fixes: Differentiate settlement markers with distinct shape and placement.

top_issues: Sidebar panel shares identical visual weight with background feed.
fixes: Increase elevation contrast on active transaction inspector.

top_issues: Extreme customization toggles shift focus away from key management.
fixes: Group aesthetic settings separately from security controls.

top_issues: Matrix of From/To cards presents high cognitive load for routine transfers.
fixes: Adopt clearer stepped source-and-destination visual path.

top_issues: Card grid feels sparse and disconnected from balance summaries.
fixes: Consolidate hub management actions into structured list views.

top_issues: Testnet faucet operations occupy primary dashboard real estate.
fixes: Separate development tools from production asset balances.

top_issues: Lending pool health and liquidity depth lack immediate context.
fixes: Surface counterparty pool utilization alongside offer parameters.

top_issues: Dense cryptographic governance copy lacks visual guidance.
fixes: Implement a clear quorum threshold visualization diagram.

top_issues: Evidence bundle export is under-prioritized relative to technical IDs.
fixes: Elevate download actions and streamline cryptographic metadata.

top_issues: Information density causes severe scanning fatigue across wide table.
fixes: Provide clear cell borders and align related numeric columns.

top_issues: Command palette options lack contextual category dividers.
fixes: Group jump commands by task domain with distinct section headers.

overall.verdict: The interface demonstrates rigorous protocol concepts through consistent dark-mode styling and systematic bar visualizations. Usability remains constrained by heavy cryptographic jargon and dense technical controls across common flows.
priority_fixes: Simplify multi-part balance bar graphics into plain language totals.
Fix modal backdrop opacity to eliminate background bleeding on overlays.
Separate everyday payment flows from technical credit and collateral parameters.
Group command palette and settings options by high-level task domains.
Provide plain-language summaries for bilateral disputes and proof verification.
